comments.author: Tale_
comments.body:
Skill description from the game:
On Land where you have completed Land Region Investigations, clicking on an object on the Surveying Map will teleport you to the location.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
A couple of things to note about this aide skill:

-This only works for the toon that has it, not the whole fleet.

-If you are doing land charting and use this while measuring land distance area, this will remove any progress you made.
